components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary{height:40px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:9999px;border:1px solid rgb(196 181 253/.6);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,rgb(255 255 255/.18),transparent 70%),linear-gradient(155deg,#9061f9 0%,#7c3aed 40%,#4c1d95 100%);color:white;font:600 14px var(--font-poppins),sans-serif;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgb(255 255 255/.3),0 8px 24px -8px rgb(139 92 246/.65);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}.ds-primary:hover{border-color:rgb(221 214 254/.9);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgb(255 255 255/.4),0 10px 28px -8px rgb(139 92 246/.85)}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Category Filter
components.css: .ds-filter{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:9999px;overflow:auto}.ds-filter button{min-height:36px;padding:4px 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9999px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font:500 12px var(--font-poppins),sans-serif}.ds-filter button[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--surface);border-color:var(--line-strong);color:var(--fg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft)}.ds-filter button:hover{color:var(--fg)}.ds-filter button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px}

donts: Don't introduce a décor-specific brand or replacement button style.
Don't substitute invented device scenes for unavailable categories.
Don't treat test-shim previews as authenticated end-to-end validation.
keyCharacteristics: Preview and editing remain part of the same workspace.
dos: Do preserve Kinetik's existing theme, typography and shared controls.
Do use the six real photographs and truthful category availability.
Do keep preview, fit settings and upload feedback readable on mobile.
narrative.overview: This is a feature-scoped record of the shipped interface, not a new brand direction. Photo-led scenes sit within the application's neutral surfaces and violet action language. The existing light and dark theme tokens remain authoritative.

rules.body: Preserve the application's theme variables rather than introducing a décor-specific palette. The shared primary button retains its existing violet gradient and inset highlight; do not flatten or redesign that primitive based on the global stylesheet's flat-accent commentary.
rules.name: The Existing Palette Rule

extensions.scope: Feature-scoped extraction; live theme variables inherit from the app. Scene images require the app origin.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: Image hover; removed for reduced motion.
